_comment: Approved HIGH-severity vulnerability exceptions. A HIGH finding with a valid (non-expired) entry naming its exact CVE+package reports WARN instead of FAIL -- matching is per-CVE-per-package, not 'any entry exists' (that was a real bug in tests/security/runner.js, fixed 2026-08-21). CRITICAL findings can never be excepted here, by design and by explicit policy: tests/security/runner.js's isExcepted() hard-rejects severity!=='HIGH' before ever checking this file, and gate.js treats any blocking CRITICAL FAIL as an automatic NO-GO regardless of this file's content. Expiry is checked programmatically against the run date; an expired entry reports FAIL, no manual override. First real triage (2026-08-21, docs/evidence/CVE_TRIAGE.md) found strong non-exploitability evidence for several CRITICAL findings (unused CLI tools, a disabled feature flag, a 32-bit-only advisory on a 64-bit deployment) -- none of that evidence is recorded as an exception here, because none of it is eligible: it's CRITICAL-severity, full stop. That evidence stays in the triage report as risk-prioritization context, not as a gate override.

exceptions.reason: net/http+golang.org/x/net/idna DoS in Grafana's Go runtime, CVSS 8.2, externally reachable pre-auth (proxy publishes 0.0.0.0:3000, no auth_request gate on the route that serves Grafana). No official patched Grafana build exists yet -- verified live 2026-08-21 by pulling and scanning the two newest available tags (13.1.4, latest 13.1.x; 13.2.0, latest minor); both still ship a vulnerable Go stdlib build. Full analysis: docs/evidence/SECURITY_REACHABILITY.md.
exceptions.mitigation: nginx rate limiting (limit_req_zone rate=100r/s, burst=2500 nodelay) + header/URL size cap (large_client_header_buffers 4 16k) added to proxy/nginx.conf 2026-08-21. Verified with real HTTP load, not assumed: 0/2300 requests throttled at a 20-concurrent-kiosk-equivalent burst (matches real browser-measured ~115 requests per dashboard load), genuine 429 rejections confirmed above that threshold (1013/2875 at 25 kiosks) -- proves the limiter is both non-disruptive to real traffic and actually active. Does not close the CVE; bounds exploitation volume and worst-case input size. Full test evidence: docs/evidence/SECURITY_MITIGATION_P7.md.

exceptions.reason: net/http unencrypted-HTTP/2 DoS in Grafana's Go runtime, CVSS 7.5, same reachability facts as CVE-2026-39821 above (same binary, same pre-auth parsing layer, same tags checked with no fix present).
exceptions.mitigation: Same nginx rate limiting as CVE-2026-39821 -- see that entry and docs/evidence/SECURITY_MITIGATION_P7.md for the shared verification evidence.

exceptions.reason: net/url quadratic-complexity DoS in Grafana's Go runtime, CVSS 7.5, same reachability facts as CVE-2026-39821 above -- and the specific CVE the header/URL size cap most directly bounds (limits the worst-case input size the vulnerable parser ever processes from a single request).
exceptions.mitigation: Same nginx rate limiting + large_client_header_buffers cap as CVE-2026-39821 -- see that entry and docs/evidence/SECURITY_MITIGATION_P7.md.
